specification.purpose: Popup window for selecting which tab to close when limit is exceeded
requirements: Display all tabs from the current window
Show tab title, favicon, and URL
Allow user to select one tab to close
Confirm button to close selected tab
Cancel option to close the new tab instead

implementation_order: Style with selector.css for clear UI
Update background.js to open selector window
Add message passing between background and selector

html_structure.header: Title: 'Tab limit reached - Choose a tab to close'

javascript_functionality.onLoad: Get windowId from URL params, load all tabs
javascript_functionality.displayTabs: Show all tabs with favicons and titles
javascript_functionality.confirmClose: Send selected tab ID to background
javascript_functionality.cancelAction: Close this selector window and new tab

structure: Subheader: 'This window has exceeded its X tab limit'
